name: ottplay-android
description: The native kotlin/compose android and android tv player.
description_good_justification: The README describes the native Android/Android TV media player, supported user-supplied sources, offline demonstration and device/provider limitations. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/README.md
interact_justification: The README explains how to obtain a preview, install it, add sources, report issues and contribute. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/README.md
contribution_justification: Public contribution instructions specify focused issues/PRs, sanitized reproductions, compatibility discussion, test commands and review. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: Contributors must preserve authorship/licenses, explain behavior changes and add regression tests, documentation and release notes. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: Original project source is distributed under MIT, with third-party notices retained separately. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/LICENSE
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is an OSI-approved FLOSS license. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/LICENSE
license_location_justification: The complete MIT text is in root LICENSE; NOTICE identifies bundled wrapper and fixture provenance. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/LICENSE
documentation_basics_justification: The README gives installation, source setup, playback, runtime requirements and build instructions. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/README.md
documentation_interface_justification: The provider, import/export, track preference and native DRM interfaces and unsupported cases are documented. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/DRM.md
sites_https_justification: GitHub source, issues and releases and the linked static privacy website use HTTPS. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/README.md
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests support public proposals, review and reconsideration of decisions. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/GOVERNANCE.md
english_justification: English is the common language for code review and project documentation. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/CONTRIBUTING.md
maintained_justification: Current source and signed previews are maintained, with an October 2026–October 2027 roadmap and an explicit latest-release security policy. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/ROADMAP.md
repo_public_justification: The maintained source and source history are public on GitHub. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android
repo_track_justification: Git records versioned files, changes and attribution. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Public commits and PRs expose intermediate work between published previews. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/pulls?q=is%3Apr
repo_distributed_justification: Git is a distributed version-control system. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android
version_unique_justification: version.properties identifies the base version and monotonically advancing Android versionCode; preview tags include their unique version code. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/version.properties
version_semver_justification: Stable bases use major.minor.patch and previews add an explicit prerelease suffix; the release helper rejects invalid or reused versions. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/scripts/release.py
version_tags_justification: Versioned tags identify published previews, including v0.2.1-preview.5. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/releases/tag/v0.2.1-preview.5
release_notes_justification: All four existing published previews provide substantive behavior and upgrade notes. Reviewed corrections describe the preview.4 TLS certificate-key policy, preview.5 playlist-line bound and preview.2 native features while preserving its historical build/source distinction. Preview.3 already documents its shared-core change. No asset or tag was replaced. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: No assigned CVE, GHSA or similar identifier for a vulnerability in this project's released runtime was found in the authenticated advisory inventory, complete published release notes, or security history. This criterion excludes dependencies and only requires identifiers already assigned when a release was made; useful ID-less security notes remain published. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/releases https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/security/advisories
report_process_justification: CONTRIBUTING directs public bugs and enhancements to GitHub issues with exact version, environment and sanitized reproduction. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_tracker_justification: GitHub issues are the public report tracker. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/issues
report_responses_justification: On 2026-10-16 no non-PR GitHub reports were found; the maintainer confirmed no outside-GitHub reports over the preceding 12 months. There is no unanswered qualifying report in that inventory. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
enhancement_responses_justification: The same dated inventory and maintainer confirmation identify no outside or GitHub enhancement requests requiring a response. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
report_archive_justification: GitHub retains public reports and their discussion, including closed issues. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY documents confidential reporting, scope, maintained versions and response/disclosure commitments. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: The linked GitHub private reporting form is enabled. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: The maintainer confirmed no external vulnerability reports over the preceding 12 months and none were identified in the reviewed GitHub inventory. Response commitments are policies, not invented past response measurements. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
build_justification: The checked-in Gradle Wrapper and module build files automate JVM tests, Android APK/AAB builds and explicit signed release construction. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/README.md
build_common_tools_justification: Builds use Gradle, Kotlin/JVM, JDK and standard Android tooling, with documented commands. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/README.md
build_floss_tools_justification: The Android APK/AAB build uses FLOSS Temurin/OpenJDK 17, Gradle 9.8.1, AGP 9.4.1, Kotlin 2.4.20, Android platform 37 API stubs and SDK 36 build/signing tools. Exact installed package notices and plugin POM licenses were reviewed: Android tools/AGP/Kotlin use Apache-2.0, R8 uses BSD terms, with component notices preserved. SDK agreement section 3.5 applies the components' own open-source licenses. The required build does not need a proprietary compiler or signer. Optional Google emulator images, OEM firmware and runtime DRM are separate; this does not label them FLOSS. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/tree/94b18bb21204fb51e9c96fbacd00487dafe749a0 https://developer.android.com/studio/terms https://android.googlesource.com/platform/tools/apksig/+/refs/heads/main/LICENSE https://r8.googlesource.com/r8/+/refs/heads/main/LICENSE
test_justification: The project has JVM, Android unit, instrumentation and Python release-helper test suites. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/VALIDATION.md
test_invocation_justification: Documented Gradle tasks and unittest discovery execute the respective suites. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/CONTRIBUTING.md
test_most_justification: Broad tests exist, but no current complete-source coverage report establishes that most code is exercised. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub CI runs host tests, lint/builds and designated phone/TV emulator jobs; release preflight requires source-matched host and both device results. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/./.github/workflows/android.yml
test_policy_justification: Behavior changes require automated tests or a documented reason and reproducible manual procedure if automation is infeasible. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added_justification: Recent certificate-key changes include real transport, redirect, reuse and resumption regressions alongside exact-key JVM tests. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/app/src/androidTest/java/play/ott/nativeapp/security/TlsKeyStrengthInstrumentedTest.kt
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING explicitly documents addition of regression and new-behavior tests. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings_justification: Required Android CI runs compiler diagnostics and both debug/release Android Lint checks. This supplies automated mistake detection as required here; a full Python-helper diagnostic baseline and maximal strictness are separate work. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/.github/workflows/android.yml
warnings_fixed_justification: The enabled Kotlin compiler and Android lint diagnostics were reviewed and fixed on the current source. The exact PR72 build passed all JVM tests, debug/release lint, debug/release/full APK and AAB assembly, and instrumentation compilation without owned-source compiler warnings. Three necessary legacy API uses have narrow, documented compatibility suppressions. Gradle warning.mode=all remains enabled; AGP 9.4.1 Configuration.setVisible and SDK-manager CLI deprecations remain visible and are separately documented as upstream tool diagnostics. This does not claim that external tools produce no diagnostics or that emulator/device qualification has completed. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/94b18bb21204fb51e9c96fbacd00487dafe749a0/docs/VALIDATION.md https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/actions/runs/38999707115/job/117299927780
warnings_strict_justification: A strict warning configuration for every maintained implementation language has not been demonstrated. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/./.github/workflows/android.yml
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer confirmed familiarity with secure-design principles; trust and credential boundaries are documented. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer confirmed familiarity with common application/network vulnerabilities and prevention. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
crypto_published_justification: Owned transports use TLS and stored source data uses AES-GCM, but all cryptographic protocols in external native DRM/platform components have not been assessed. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/DRM.md
crypto_call_justification: Owned code delegates primitives to platform JCA/Android Keystore, TLS and native MediaDrm rather than implementing new encryption primitives. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/app/src/main/java/play/ott/nativeapp/data/SourceVault.kt
crypto_floss_justification: The complete advertised feature set includes external Widevine/PlayReady platform components; an equivalent complete FLOSS cryptographic implementation has not been established. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/DRM.md
crypto_keylength_justification: Owned HTTP clients enforce exact certificate key floors, but external DRM/platform, TLS key-exchange parameters and build/release transports remain outside that qualification. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/security-design.md
crypto_working_justification: No complete algorithm/mode assessment covers the external native DRM and release-tool closure; the verified owned TLS guard is narrower evidence. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Whole-project cryptographic weakness assessment remains incomplete across external DRM/platform and release dependencies. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
crypto_pfs_justification: A complete forward-secrecy assessment for all maintained network and release-tool paths is not established. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/security-design.md
crypto_password_storage_justification: The app retains outbound provider credentials, not passwords used to authenticate users to this app. Outbound credentials are outside this specific password-storage criterion; source storage is encrypted and explicit manual exports contain plaintext credentials. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/privacy-policy.md
crypto_random_justification: Owned AES-GCM delegates key and IV generation to Android Keystore/JCA, but cryptographic randomness across the complete external platform/DRM and signing closure has not been qualified. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/app/src/main/java/play/ott/nativeapp/data/SourceVault.kt
delivery_mitm_justification: Project source and APK/AAB artifacts are delivered through HTTPS GitHub; the published manifest and SHA256SUMS identify the exact preview. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/RELEASING.md
delivery_unsigned_justification: SHA256SUMS and the release manifest are distributed through the same HTTPS project release endpoint. APK/AAB signing is an additional distinct mechanism. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/RELEASING.md
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: Zero Dependabot alerts does not establish remediation of all medium-or-higher vulnerabilities in the complete Android/runtime/release-tool closure. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: The complete external runtime and build/release dependency closure has not been audited for applicable critical vulnerabilities. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The 2026-10-16 default-rule Gitleaks 8.30.1 scan of the unshallowed history inspected all 85 commits without path/detector exclusions. Its sole finding is the documented public synthetic ClearKey for self-owned test media, used only by a loopback test server; no operator credential was identified. This is bounded evidence, not a claim to detect every possible secret format. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL analyzes Actions, Kotlin/Java and Python; Android Lint checks Android-specific issues. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/./.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL is configured for maintained Kotlin/Java, Python and Actions, including a real Android compilation for Kotlin extraction. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/./.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_fixed_justification: The current authenticated inventory contains eight Scorecard process-policy recommendations and no open CodeQL source finding. None of those eight entries identifies a confirmed exploitable source vulnerability. The project retains its remediation policy; this result does not claim complete dependency, DRM or platform qualification. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/security/code-scanning
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on main pushes, PRs and a weekly schedule; Android lint is in ordinary CI. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/./.github/workflows/codeql.yml
dynamic_analysis_justification: The recorded host/emulator/TLS scenarios are ordinary fixed-case regression tests. No qualifying input-varying dynamic-analysis tool or measured test-suite branch coverage of at least 80 percent is established. These tests remain useful validation without being relabeled as this criterion. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/VALIDATION.md
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Owned implementation is Kotlin/Java/Python and shell rather than project-owned memory-unsafe C/C++; no sanitizer assertion is made about external Android/DRM native components. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/VALIDATION.md
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: JUnit/instrumentation/unittest assertions remain enabled and failures block qualification; TLS negative tests assert no origin request is sent. Evidence: https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/app/src/androidTest/java/play/ott/nativeapp/security/TlsKeyStrengthInstrumentedTest.kt
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No qualifying fuzzing/varied-input analysis or automated suite with measured 80-percent branch coverage has been established. The existing host/emulator/TLS checks are ordinary fixed-case tests, and no vulnerability discovered by qualifying dynamic analysis is known. Physical-device and commercial-provider gaps are not the reason for this N/A selection. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/VALIDATION.md https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-android/blob/dd28a7ed1a03b1766c47f63a48a3dc4185ded078/docs/openssf-evidence.md
